chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Treat your families every Friday with some fruit and meat, so that they may rejoice in Friday."

key_terms.بِالْجُمُعَةِ: Because of Friday; in connection with Jumu'ah
key_terms.يَفْرَحُوا: They may rejoice or be happy

ai.seo_question: How should Muslims make Jumu'ah a joyful day for their families?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages showing kindness and care to one’s family on the day of Jumu'ah by giving them enjoyable provisions. It highlights making Jumu'ah a day of happiness and warmth within the household.
